def: A formal grammar of recursive production rules that defines which strings are valid; constrained decoding uses one to force output into code, DSLs or formats a JSON Schema cannot express.
practice: OpenAI custom tools accept Lark grammars, llama.cpp uses its BNF-based GBNF, and engines such as XGrammar and llguidance compile grammars into token masks; spell it out, since CFG also means classifier-free guidance.
